_about: Demo household for `guardian seed`. Every recall these items can match is a real record from the live CPSC, NHTSA and openFDA feeds as of 2026-09-13: Boon NURSH bottles (CPSC 26530, UPC 669028116546), Cade California Electronic finger lights (CPSC 26761), Hampton Bay Halwin ceiling fan (CPSC 26702, UPC 840059614922), and three NHTSA campaigns filed against 2019 Subaru Outbacks. The other items exist so the sweep has clear and adjudicated-no rows too. Purchase details and the VIN are illustrative.
